limits: Brainiacs Robotics, Coding and AI: general FAQ and Terms 11 confirm online award is digital even when discipline pages use medal labels. On-site medals by percentile are separate. Direct online registration exists without a national partner. Price and payment acceptance from the family country require confirmation.

Robotics: team of one or two in one age category. Grades 1–6 entry, 5 minute physical robot video, qualification from 40%. AI and Robotics discipline-specific results dates conflict with the main STEM schedule. Actual competition dates and deadlines agree. Do not infer a results date from the main calendar.

Brainiacs Science Project has Grades 5–12 and up to three participants, proposal and project result submission by 26 November. 30 November is finalist announcement. Final window 25–31 March, exact assignment to confirm.

GRC official calendar 18–19 December 2026, applications until 15 November, host city/country and discipline times unconfirmed. Historical Cairo, Assiut and Riyadh locations are separate. GRC registration accepts independent groups and asks for country. This does not prove any specific foreign team has been accepted.

All 13 GRC portal categories and their linked rulebooks were captured. Public index allows 1–4 students (Go Dive 3–7), PDF states 2–4 with coach (Go Dive 3–5). General FAQ uses first championship day for age, category pages 1 Jan 2026. Terms limit each student to one team per season. English and Arabic rulebook publication does not establish judging language.

GRC Billiards ages 6–10 and Expo Junior 6–12 depend on the age cutoff for a 2020 birth. Scratch splits Discover 5–7 and Junior 8–11. SUMO PDF says 1 kg for LEGO Mini, portal side summary 500 g. F1 portal hardware summary conflicts with its PDF, which describes a manually controlled car and LEGO for Junior.

GRC portal lists EGP 13,475.27 per team on all thirteen categories. The $250.00 secondary display lacks an explicit currency code. No charge or seat reserve. Final venue, payments, documentation, prize and fee terms should be confirmed.

Coding Lab Junior births 2017–2019, registration closes 6 December 18:00 GMT+8, project and video 10 January 18:00, results 28 February 12:00. SGD 92.65 incl GST. Linked full rules returned HTTP 401. Foreign acceptance, team format and award form unknown.

Cairo ICT, AIDC² and PAFIX 7–10 November adult halls. Connecta Hall 4 8–10 November family access. Connecta Play allows open stations, individual age restrictions and guardian consent for tournaments. AI hackathon exact slot and registration gates unavailable.
